preconditions.description: n must be a positive integer between 1 and 10000.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must only contain the characters '0' and '1'.
The output string must represent the first n digits of the Thue-Morse sequence.
